summary: Elin Hansson from Carnegie Fonder presents US Small & Micro Cap strategy focusing on quality companies with strong profitability, cash flows, and low leverage. Key themes include data center infrastructure (Stirling), medical packaging (UFP Technologies), housing recovery plays (Trex, Simpson), and specialty insurance (Kinsale, Palomar). The discussion also covers Swedish small caps including Kopparbergs, Björn Borg, and Nibe.
key_takeaways: Quality focus: only 15% of small caps meet profitability and cash flow criteria
Data center infrastructure remains strong investment theme with major capex increases
US housing market has 1.8-2M unit deficit creating pent-up demand
Specialty insurance companies using technology to price niche risks have competitive advantages
Dollar 15% cheaper than a year ago gives Swedish investors better entry
